an6.69:1.1: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.69:1.2: ‘cha yime bhante dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
an6.69:1.4: Satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, sovacassatā, kalyāṇamittatā.
an6.69:1.5: Ime kho bhante cha dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī' ti.
an6.69:1.8: Atha kho sā devatā ‘samanuñño me Satthā' ti Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 2.
an6.69:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
an6.69:2.2: ‘imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave sā devatā maṃ etad avoca:
an6.69:2.3: Cha yime bhante dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
an6.69:2.5: Satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, sovacassatā, kalyāṇamittatā.
an6.69:2.6: Ime kho bhante cha dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī ti.
an6.69:2.8: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyī' ti. 3.
an6.69:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā etad avoca:--
an6.69:3.2: Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
an6.69:3.3: Idha bhante bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī,
an6.69:3.4: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā, te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti,
an6.69:3.5: ye c' aññe bhikkhū satthugāravā, tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an6.69:3.11: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā, te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti,
an6.69:3.12: ye c' aññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā, tesañ ca vaññaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an6.69:3.13: Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī ti.
an6.69:4.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ Sāriputta imassa mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
an6.69:4.3: Idha Sāriputta bhikkhu attanā ca satthugāravo hoti satthugāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī,
an6.69:4.4: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na satthugāravā, te ca satthugāravatāya samādapeti,
an6.69:4.5: ye c' aññe bhikkhū satthugāravā, tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an6.69:4.11: ye c' aññe bhikkhū na kalyāṇamittā, te ca kalyāṇamittatāya samādapeti,
an6.69:4.12: ye c' aññe bhikkhū kalyāṇamittā, tesañ ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena.
an6.69:4.13: Imassa kho Sāriputta mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo'
